title: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5

blocks.source_text: This week's snapshot comes packed with a bunch of new things for you to try out! In 26.4 Snapshot 5, we're introducing Packed Ice Bricks, including a bunch of variants, and YES, they work in the Stonecutter! We've also got a frosty new advancement for anyone who decides to fight ice with ice and take out a Frostbite with an Ice Ball.
blocks.translated_text: 本周的快照更新带来了许多新的内容供您尝试！在26.4 Snapshot 5中，我们引入了“压缩冰砖”（Packed Ice Bricks），包括多种变体，而且这些压缩冰砖可以在切石机（Stonecutter）中使用！对于那些选择用冰来对抗冰敌人，并通过投掷冰球（Ice Ball）击败敌人的人来说，还有一个全新的成就系统。

blocks.source_text: Happy Mining!
blocks.translated_text: 祝你采矿愉快！

blocks.source_text: New Features
blocks.translated_text: 新功能

blocks.source_text: Added Packed Ice Bricks
blocks.translated_text: 新增了“压缩冰砖”

blocks.source_text: Packed Ice Bricks
blocks.translated_text: “压缩冰砖”

blocks.source_text: Packed Ice Bricks can be crafted from 2x2 Packed Ice
blocks.translated_text: “压缩冰砖”可以通过2x2的“压缩冰”（Packed Ice）材料制作出来

blocks.source_text: Packed Ice Bricks have a Slab, Stair, Wall, and Chiseled variant
blocks.translated_text: “压缩冰砖”有平板（Slab）、楼梯（Stair）、墙壁（Wall）和雕刻（Chiseled）三种类型

blocks.source_text: Packed Ice Brick Slabs, Stairs, Walls, as well as Chiseled Packed Ice can also be crafted using a Stonecutter
blocks.translated_text: “压缩冰砖”制成的平板、楼梯和墙壁，以及经过雕刻处理的压缩冰，同样可以使用切石机进行制作

blocks.source_text: Packed Ice Bricks and Chiseled Packed Ice belong to the Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube archetype
blocks.translated_text: “压缩冰砖”和经过雕刻处理的压缩冰属于“快速滑动的硫方怪”（Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube）原型

blocks.source_text: Advancements
blocks.translated_text: 成就系统更新

blocks.source_text: Added new "What Goes Around Comes Around" Adventure advancement for killing a Frostbite with an Ice Ball
blocks.translated_text: 新增了“因果循环”冒险模式成就，用于使用冰球杀死“冻伤”怪物

blocks.source_text: Changes
blocks.translated_text: 变更

blocks.source_text: Mobs can now break Decorated Pots, Chorus Flowers and Speleothem blocks with projectiles in an adventure mode world, unless the mob_griefing gamerule is set to false
blocks.translated_text: 在冒险模式的世界中，怪物现在可以用投射物破坏装饰花盆、紫颂之花和洞穴石块，除非游戏规则「mob_griefing」被设置为「false」

blocks.source_text: Sounds
blocks.translated_text: 音效

blocks.source_text: Added ambient sounds to regular Ice block
blocks.translated_text: 为普通的冰块添加了环境音效

blocks.source_text: When an Ice block is surrounded by at least 8 Ice blocks in all horizontal directions (east, west, north, and south), with one Air block above and one Water block below, it has a chance to emit a sound
blocks.translated_text: 当一个冰块在所有水平方向（东、西、北、南）上至少被8个冰块包围，上方有1个空气块，下方有1个水块时，它有可能发出音效

blocks.source_text: Video Settings
blocks.translated_text: 视频设置

blocks.source_text: "Prefer DXGI Present" Video Setting
blocks.translated_text: “优先使用 DirectX 渲染”视频设置

blocks.source_text: This is a new option to attempt to use DirectX to present the game
blocks.translated_text: 这是一个新选项，用于尝试使用 DirectX 来渲染游戏

blocks.source_text: This only exists on Windows, and not all hardware supports it
blocks.translated_text: 此功能仅存在于 Windows 上，且并非所有硬件都支持

blocks.source_text: The default is off, and we consider this option "experimental" - it may not work for everyone
blocks.translated_text: 默认情况下这个功能是关闭的，我们将其视为“实验性”功能——可能并不适用于所有玩家

blocks.source_text: With DXGI enabled, you *may* see improvements with IME support, Variable Refresh Rate support, and faster alt-tabbing whilst in fullscreen mode
blocks.translated_text: 启用 DXGI 后，您可能会发现输入法(IME)支持、可变刷新率支持以及在全屏模式下使用 Alt+Tab 切换窗口的速度有所提升

blocks.source_text: Technical Changes
blocks.translated_text: 技术性变更

blocks.source_text: The Data Pack version is now 125.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包的版本现在为 125.0

blocks.source_text: The Resource Pack version is now 100.2
blocks.translated_text: 资源包的版本现在为 100.2

blocks.source_text: Network Protocol
blocks.translated_text: 网络协议

blocks.source_text: Modified Login Protocol
blocks.translated_text: 登录协议已修改

blocks.source_text: Encryption and compression must now be explicitly applied by the server by sending one of two packets that carry connection options
blocks.translated_text: 加密和压缩功能现在必须由服务器通过发送两种数据包之一来明确执行，这些数据包包含了连接选项

blocks.source_text: The client must acknowledge the change with a matching packet
blocks.translated_text: 客户端必须用相应的数据包来确认这一变更

blocks.source_text: Every packet sent and received by the client after the acknowledgement will use the new settings
blocks.translated_text: 在确认变更之后，客户端发送和接收的所有数据包都将使用新的设置

blocks.source_text: Previously changes were applied immediately on both sides, which might've lead to malformed packets
blocks.translated_text: 之前，更改会在双方立即生效，这可能会导致数据包格式错误。

blocks.source_text: Packets that can carry options:
blocks.translated_text: 可以携带选项的数据包：

blocks.source_text: minecraft:login_finished (clientbound) and minecraft:login_acknowledged (serverbound)
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:login_finished (客户端发送) 和 minecraft:login_acknowledged (服务器接收)

blocks.source_text: minecraft:apply_options (clientbound) and minecraft:options_applied (serverbound)
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:apply_options (客户端发送) 和 minecraft:options_applied (服务器接收)

blocks.source_text: Data Pack Version 125.0
blocks.translated_text: 数据包版本 125.0

blocks.source_text: Data Components
blocks.translated_text: 数据组件（Data Components）

blocks.source_text: minecraft:consumable
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:consumable

blocks.source_text: The sound field is now fully optional (defaulted to minecraft:entity.generic.eat before)
blocks.translated_text: 现在声音字段是完全可选的（默认值为 minecraft:entity.generic.eat）

blocks.source_text: minecraft:equippable
blocks.translated_text: minecraft:equippable

blocks.source_text: The equip_sound field is now fully optional (defaulted to minecraft:item.armor.equip_generic )
blocks.translated_text: 现在装备声音字段是完全可选的（默认值为 minecraft:item.armor.equip_generic）

blocks.source_text: The shearing_sound field is now fully optional (defaulted to minecraft:item.shears.snip )
blocks.translated_text: “shearing_sound”字段现在完全是可选的（默认值为 `minecraft:item.shears.snip`）

upscale
blocks.translated_text: 放大（Upscale）

blocks.source_text: (renamed from
blocks.translated_text: (从...重命名而来)

blocks.source_text: interpolated
blocks.translated_text: 插值（Interpolate）
空

blocks.source_text: Samples the input function at a reduced resolution, and upscales on each axis with the specified modes. Modes that require more samples will generally perform worse. Upscaling is performed by axis in order: Z, X, then Y.
blocks.translated_text: 以较低的分辨率采样输入函数，并根据指定的模式在每个轴上进行放大。需要更多样本的模式通常性能较差。放大按轴顺序进行：Z轴、X轴、然后是Y轴。

blocks.source_text: Format: object with fields:
blocks.translated_text: 格式：一个包含字段的对象

blocks.source_text: input - Density Function, the input function to sample
blocks.translated_text: input - 密度函数（Density Function），即要采样的输入函数

blocks.source_text: x , y , z - object with fields, the configuration for this axis
blocks.translated_text: x, y, z - 包含字段的对象，表示该轴的配置

blocks.source_text: mode - one of: nearest_neighbor , interpolate_linear , interpolate_cosine , interpolate_cubic , b_spline_cubic , the mode to use
blocks.translated_text: mode - 可选模式包括：nearest_neighbor, interpolate_linear, interpolate_cosine, interpolate_cubic, b_spline_cubic

blocks.source_text: nearest_neighbor
blocks.translated_text: nearest_neighbor

blocks.source_text: 1 sample per axis
blocks.translated_text: 每个轴上取1个样本

blocks.source_text: Value is discontinuous across cell boundaries, gradient is always 0
blocks.translated_text: 值在单元格边界处是不连续的，梯度始终为0

blocks.source_text: Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value
blocks.translated_text: 单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

blocks.source_text: interpolate_linear
blocks.translated_text: 线性插值

blocks.source_text: 2 samples per axis
blocks.translated_text: 每个轴上取2个样本

blocks.source_text: Value is continuous, gradient is constant within a cell but discontinuous across cell boundaries
blocks.translated_text: 值是连续的，但在单元格内梯度保持不变，在单元格边界处是不连续的

blocks.source_text: Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value
blocks.translated_text: 单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

blocks.source_text: interpolate_cosine
blocks.translated_text: 余弦插值

blocks.source_text: 2 samples per axis
blocks.translated_text: 每个轴上取2个样本

blocks.source_text: Value and gradient are continuous
blocks.translated_text: 值和梯度都是连续的

blocks.source_text: Gradient is 0 at cell boundaries
blocks.translated_text: 单元格边界处的梯度值为 0

blocks.source_text: Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value
blocks.translated_text: 单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

blocks.source_text: interpolate_cubic
blocks.translated_text: 插值方法：cubic

blocks.source_text: 4 samples per axis
blocks.translated_text: 每个轴上有 4 个采样点

blocks.source_text: Value and gradient are continuous
blocks.translated_text: 值和梯度是连续的

blocks.source_text: Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value
blocks.translated_text: 单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

blocks.source_text: b_spline_cubic
blocks.translated_text: 插值方法：b_spline_cubic

blocks.source_text: 4 samples per axis
blocks.translated_text: 每个轴上有 4 个采样点

blocks.source_text: Value and gradient are continuous
blocks.translated_text: 值和梯度是连续的

blocks.source_text: Values at cell vertices do not necessarily equal the cell value
blocks.translated_text: 单元格顶点的值不一定等于该单元格的值

blocks.source_text: cell_size - integer between 1 and 64, the size of each upscaling cell
blocks.translated_text: cell_size - 一个介于1到64之间的整数，表示每个放大单元的大小

blocks.source_text: Tags
blocks.translated_text: 标签

blocks.source_text: Biome Tags
blocks.translated_text: 生物群系标签

blocks.source_text: Added #spawns_ice_variants_underground to describe all biomes which allow the spawning of cold variants without requiring sky access
blocks.translated_text: 添加了#spawns_ice_variants_underground标签，用于描述所有允许生成寒冷变体的生物群系，而这些生物群系不需要能够看到天空

blocks.source_text: Renamed spawns_strays_without_powder_snow to spawns_cold_variants_underground
blocks.translated_text: 将spawns_strays_without_powder_snow重命名为spawns_cold_variants_underground

blocks.source_text: Entity Type Tags
blocks.translated_text: 实体类型标签

blocks.source_text: Replaced the #ignores_poison_and_regen tag with separate #immune_to_poison and #immune_to_regeneration tags
blocks.translated_text: 将#ignores-poison_and_regen标签替换为独立的#immune_to_poison和#immune_to_regeneration标签

blocks.source_text: Renamed the #freeze_immune_entity_types tag to #immune_to_freezing
blocks.translated_text: 将#freeze_immune_entity_types标签重命名为#immune_to_freezing

blocks.source_text: Added #immune_to_wither for mobs that are immune to the wither effect
blocks.translated_text: 为对‘凋零’效果免疫的怪物添加了#immune_to_wither标签

blocks.source_text: Added #immune_to_weakness for mobs that are immune to the weakness effect
blocks.translated_text: 为对‘虚弱’效果免疫的怪物添加了#immune_to_weakness标签

blocks.translated_text: 资源包版本 100.2

content:
This week's snapshot comes packed with a bunch of new things for you to try out! In 26.4 Snapshot 5, we're introducing Packed Ice Bricks, including a bunch of variants, and YES, they work in the Stonecutter! We've also got a frosty new advancement for anyone who decides to fight ice with ice and take out a Frostbite with an Ice Ball.

Happy Mining!

New Features

Added Packed Ice Bricks

Packed Ice Bricks

Packed Ice Bricks can be crafted from 2x2 Packed Ice

Packed Ice Bricks have a Slab, Stair, Wall, and Chiseled variant

Packed Ice Brick Slabs, Stairs, Walls, as well as Chiseled Packed Ice can also be crafted using a Stonecutter

Packed Ice Bricks and Chiseled Packed Ice belong to the Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube archetype

Advancements

Added new "What Goes Around Comes Around" Adventure advancement for killing a Frostbite with an Ice Ball

Changes

Mobs can now break Decorated Pots, Chorus Flowers and Speleothem blocks with projectiles in an adventure mode world, unless the mob_griefing gamerule is set to false

Sounds

Added ambient sounds to regular Ice block

When an Ice block is surrounded by at least 8 Ice blocks in all horizontal directions (east, west, north, and south), with one Air block above and one Water block below, it has a chance to emit a sound

Video Settings

"Prefer DXGI Present" Video Setting

This is a new option to attempt to use DirectX to present the game

This only exists on Windows, and not all hardware supports it

The default is off, and we consider this option "experimental" - it may not work for everyone

With DXGI enabled, you *may* see improvements with IME support, Variable Refresh Rate support, and faster alt-tabbing whilst in fullscreen mode

Technical Changes

The Data Pack version is now 125.0

The Resource Pack version is now 100.2

Network Protocol

Modified Login Protocol

Encryption and compression must now be explicitly applied by the server by sending one of two packets that carry connection options

The client must acknowledge the change with a matching packet

Every packet sent and received by the client after the acknowledgement will use the new settings

Previously changes were applied immediately on both sides, which might've lead to malformed packets

Packets that can carry options:

minecraft:login_finished (clientbound) and minecraft:login_acknowledged (serverbound)

minecraft:apply_options (clientbound) and minecraft:options_applied (serverbound)

Data Pack Version 125.0

Data Components

minecraft:consumable

The sound field is now fully optional (defaulted to minecraft:entity.generic.eat before)

minecraft:equippable

The equip_sound field is now fully optional (defaulted to minecraft:item.armor.equip_generic )

The shearing_sound field is now fully optional (defaulted to minecraft:item.shears.snip )

World Generation

Features

Changed

ore

and

scattered_ore

Blocks discarded due to air exposure will no longer fall through to the next replacement rule

Density Functions

Changed

upscale

(renamed from

interpolated

)

Samples the input function at a reduced resolution, and upscales on each axis with the specified modes. Modes that require more samples will generally perform worse. Upscaling is performed by axis in order: Z, X, then Y.

Format: object with fields:

input - Density Function, the input function to sample

x , y , z - object with fields, the configuration for this axis

mode - one of: nearest_neighbor , interpolate_linear , interpolate_cosine , interpolate_cubic , b_spline_cubic , the mode to use

nearest_neighbor

1 sample per axis

Value is discontinuous across cell boundaries, gradient is always 0

Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value

interpolate_linear

2 samples per axis

Value is continuous, gradient is constant within a cell but discontinuous across cell boundaries

Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value

interpolate_cosine

2 samples per axis

Value and gradient are continuous

Gradient is 0 at cell boundaries

Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value

interpolate_cubic

4 samples per axis

Value and gradient are continuous

Values at cell vertices always equal the cell value

b_spline_cubic

4 samples per axis

Value and gradient are continuous

Values at cell vertices do not necessarily equal the cell value

cell_size - integer between 1 and 64, the size of each upscaling cell

Tags

Biome Tags

Added #spawns_ice_variants_underground to describe all biomes which allow the spawning of cold variants without requiring sky access

Renamed spawns_strays_without_powder_snow to spawns_cold_variants_underground

Entity Type Tags

Replaced the #ignores_poison_and_regen tag with separate #immune_to_poison and #immune_to_regeneration tags

Renamed the #freeze_immune_entity_types tag to #immune_to_freezing

Added #immune_to_wither for mobs that are immune to the wither effect

Added #immune_to_weakness for mobs that are immune to the weakness effect

Resource Pack Version 100.2

Block Sprites

Added new Block textures:

block/chiseled_packed_ice.png

block/packed_ice_bricks.png

Fixed bugs in 26.4 Snapshot 5

[MC-25976](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-25976) - Blocks broken by flowing fluids do not produce particles or make breaking sounds

[MC-170550](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-170550) - The snowy_shepherds_house_1 village structure never generates

[MC-270793](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-270793) - Mobs with multiple entity type tags corresponding to effect immunity only respect one

[MC-308621](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-308621) - Race condition in the dedicated server's compression setup

[MC-312316](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312316) - Creakings still try to attack players after they switch to Creative mode

[MC-312360](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312360) - Paintings break outside the world border

[MC-312377](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312377) - The bottom face of icicles on the floor is rotated 180 degrees

[MC-312386](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312386) - The #spawns_strays_without_powder_snow biome tag's name makes no sense

[MC-312404](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312404) - Frostbites can naturally spawn in normal caves under cold biomes, unlike strays

[MC-312431](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312431) - Red and brown mushrooms now spread incorrectly

[MC-312496](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312496) - Icicle models use the deprecated shade field

[MC-312497](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312497) - Template models for icicles are not prefixed with template_

[MC-312563](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312563) - The icicle in the Creative mode inventory is placed in the wrong spot

[MC-312587](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312587) - The game crashes when trying to render the hidden tooltips of music discs in jukebox playlists

[MC-312612](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312612) - Jukeboxes can pull from double chests if a single chest was turned into a double chest after being placed

[MC-312613](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312613) - Jukeboxes don't pull discs from single chests that are created by breaking a double chest

[MC-312621](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312621) - Zombies, husks, drowned, strays, and frostbites are now affected by Poison and Regeneration

[MC-312630](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312630) - Ruined portals don't generate in ice caves

[MC-312631](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312631) - Ice caves are not part of the #stronghold_biased_to biome tag

[MC-312640](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312640) - Any mouse button can be used to select entries in the statistics menu

[MC-312641](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312641) - Any mouse button can be used to open links on the death screen

[MC-312642](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312642) - Pointed dripstone below flowing lava drips water instead of lava

[MC-312644](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312644) - Dispensers filling glass bottles don't play the bottle filling sound

[MC-312645](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312645) - Dispensers equipping chests on donkeys, mules or llamas don't play the chest equipping sound

[MC-312652](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312652) - Flint and steel and fire charges don't make a sound when igniting sulfur cubes holding TNT

[MC-312654](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312654) - Dispensers consume the durability of flint and steel and play their clicking sound despite there being nothing to ignite

[MC-312669](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312669) - Any mouse button can be used to close the friends and other players menus when clicking outside of them

[MC-312693](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312693) - Projectiles shot by mobs can no longer break decorated pots, chorus flowers, pointed dripstone, sulfur spikes, or icicles

[MC-312715](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312715) - The game crashes when a jukebox in a playlist has a negative playlist_position value

[MC-312717](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312717) - Mobs can spawn on honey blocks

Get the Snapshot

Snapshots are available for Minecraft: Java Edition. To install the Snapshot, open up the [Minecraft Launcher](https://www.minecraft.net/content/minecraft-net/language-masters/download) and enable snapshots in the "Installations" tab.

**Testing versions can corrupt your world, so please backup and/or run them in a different folder from your main worlds.**

Cross-platform server jar:

[Minecraft server jar](https://piston-data.mojang.com/v1/objects/ed041232700614aeaaf72a6ea88b7f58ca3f8e4a/server.jar)

Report bugs here:

[Minecraft issue tracker](https://bugs.mojang.com/projects/MC/summary) !

Want to give feedback?

For any feedback and suggestions, head over to the [Feedback site](https://feedback.minecraft.net/) . If you're feeling chatty, join us over at the [official Minecraft Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/minecraft) .
translated_content:
本周的快照更新带来了许多新的内容供您尝试！在26.4 Snapshot 5中，我们引入了“压缩冰砖”（Packed Ice Bricks），包括多种变体，而且这些压缩冰砖可以在切石机（Stonecutter）中使用！对于那些选择用冰来对抗冰敌人，并通过投掷冰球（Ice Ball）击败敌人的人来说，还有一个全新的成就系统。

祝你采矿愉快！

新功能

新增了“压缩冰砖”

“压缩冰砖”

“压缩冰砖”可以通过2x2的“压缩冰”（Packed Ice）材料制作出来

“压缩冰砖”有平板（Slab）、楼梯（Stair）、墙壁（Wall）和雕刻（Chiseled）三种类型

“压缩冰砖”制成的平板、楼梯和墙壁，以及经过雕刻处理的压缩冰，同样可以使用切石机进行制作

“压缩冰砖”和经过雕刻处理的压缩冰属于“快速滑动的硫方怪”（Fast Sliding Sulfur Cube）原型

成就系统更新

新增了“因果循环”冒险模式成就，用于使用冰球杀死“冻伤”怪物

变更

在冒险模式的世界中，怪物现在可以用投射物破坏装饰花盆、紫颂之花和洞穴石块，除非游戏规则「mob_griefing」被设置为「false」

音效

为普通的冰块添加了环境音效

当一个冰块在所有水平方向（东、西、北、南）上至少被8个冰块包围，上方有1个空气块，下方有1个水块时，它有可能发出音效

视频设置

“优先使用 DirectX 渲染”视频设置

这是一个新选项，用于尝试使用 DirectX 来渲染游戏

此功能仅存在于 Windows 上，且并非所有硬件都支持

默认情况下这个功能是关闭的，我们将其视为“实验性”功能——可能并不适用于所有玩家

启用 DXGI 后，您可能会发现输入法(IME)支持、可变刷新率支持以及在全屏模式下使用 Alt+Tab 切换窗口的速度有所提升

技术性变更

数据包的版本现在为 125.0

资源包的版本现在为 100.2

网络协议

登录协议已修改

加密和压缩功能现在必须由服务器通过发送两种数据包之一来明确执行，这些数据包包含了连接选项

客户端必须用相应的数据包来确认这一变更

在确认变更之后，客户端发送和接收的所有数据包都将使用新的设置

之前，更改会在双方立即生效，这可能会导致数据包格式错误。

可以携带选项的数据包：

minecraft:login_finished (客户端发送) 和 minecraft:login_acknowledged (服务器接收)

minecraft:apply_options (客户端发送) 和 minecraft:options_applied (服务器接收)

数据包版本 125.0

数据组件（Data Components）

minecraft:consumable

现在声音字段是完全可选的（默认值为 minecraft:entity.generic.eat）

minecraft:equippable

现在装备声音字段是完全可选的（默认值为 minecraft:item.armor.equip_generic）

“shearing_sound”字段现在完全是可选的（默认值为 `minecraft:item.shears.snip`）

放大（Upscale）

(从...重命名而来)

插值（Interpolate）

空

以较低的分辨率采样输入函数，并根据指定的模式在每个轴上进行放大。需要更多样本的模式通常性能较差。放大按轴顺序进行：Z轴、X轴、然后是Y轴。

格式：一个包含字段的对象

input - 密度函数（Density Function），即要采样的输入函数

x, y, z - 包含字段的对象，表示该轴的配置

mode - 可选模式包括：nearest_neighbor, interpolate_linear, interpolate_cosine, interpolate_cubic, b_spline_cubic

nearest_neighbor

每个轴上取1个样本

值在单元格边界处是不连续的，梯度始终为0

单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

线性插值

每个轴上取2个样本

值是连续的，但在单元格内梯度保持不变，在单元格边界处是不连续的

单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

余弦插值

每个轴上取2个样本

值和梯度都是连续的

单元格边界处的梯度值为 0

单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

插值方法：cubic

每个轴上有 4 个采样点

值和梯度是连续的

单元格顶点的值始终等于该单元格的值

插值方法：b_spline_cubic

每个轴上有 4 个采样点

值和梯度是连续的

单元格顶点的值不一定等于该单元格的值

cell_size - 一个介于1到64之间的整数，表示每个放大单元的大小

标签

生物群系标签

添加了#spawns_ice_variants_underground标签，用于描述所有允许生成寒冷变体的生物群系，而这些生物群系不需要能够看到天空

将spawns_strays_without_powder_snow重命名为spawns_cold_variants_underground

实体类型标签

将#ignores-poison_and_regen标签替换为独立的#immune_to_poison和#immune_to_regeneration标签

将#freeze_immune_entity_types标签重命名为#immune_to_freezing

为对‘凋零’效果免疫的怪物添加了#immune_to_wither标签

为对‘虚弱’效果免疫的怪物添加了#immune_to_weakness标签

资源包版本 100.2

方块精灵

添加了新的方块纹理：

block/chiseled_packed_ice.png

block/packed_ice_bricks.png

修复了 26.4 版本 5 中的漏洞

[MC-25976](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-25976) - 被流动的流体破坏的方块不会产生碎片或破坏音效

[MC-312360](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-312360) - 画作在世界边界之外会破碎
